decisions.executionNote: Begin left-camera approach with gradual elbow-up lift and wrist pitch; estimate depth visually before descending.
Align open left gripper over the leftmost camera, pitching toward a downward grasp while staying elbow-up.
Fine-align and close on the leftmost camera, then lift slightly to check retention in RGB.
Lift retained camera and carry toward white basket; prepare right arm in its workspace with gradual elbow-up pitch.
Position and release camera inside white basket. Align right gripper above the right-side watch without touching the nearby figure.
Withdraw left from white basket toward the next camera. Advance and lower right fingers around the watch, close, and make a small retention-check lift.
Lower and close left on the second camera. Lift right watch clear before moving inward toward blue; retention remains visually uncertain.
Carry visually retained camera to white and watch to blue, keeping both raised over basket rims and arms on their respective sides.
Release retained watch inside blue. Left camera was not retained and remains on table; return open left gripper for a lower retry.
Retry second camera with fingers 5 cm lower before closure and a short lift. Move right open gripper above gray figure; watch is visibly inside blue.
Replan from interrupted pose with smaller right-arm increments. Finish deeper camera grasp and short lift; approach gray figure overhead.
Lift the deeper left-camera grasp toward white while checking retention. Lower right around gray figure and close gently at a fixed pose.
Place second camera fully inside white and open. Lift gray figure and carry it toward red, watching that the body stays between the fingers.
Two cameras are visible in white; approach remaining camera on the left. Gray figure was not retained, so return open right gripper for a deeper grasp.
Fine-align third camera and descend to the successful camera-grasp height. Retry gray figure 28 mm deeper and slightly forward, then lift briefly to test retention.
Lift both deeper grasps first, then carry camera toward white and gray figure toward red while keeping each arm on its side.
Release third camera inside white and the retained gray figure inside red, then lift open fingers clear of the contents.
White visibly contains all three cameras. Approach remaining left watch and center-right cream figure with raised open grippers, keeping separation.
Align over the remaining watch and cream figure, lowering open fingers gradually. Check wrist alignment before final closure.
Close left around the watch band and right around the cream figure's torso at a deeper height, then lift vertically to verify both grasps.
Lift the watch and cream figure clear, then transport toward blue and red respectively, maintaining closed grippers and lateral arm separation.
Cream figure is retained; place it in red beside gray and open. Left watch slipped to the table, so return open left fingers over its new position for a lower retry.
Retry left watch lower and slightly toward its solid face, then make a short test lift. Withdraw open right arm from completed red basket toward home with gradual pitch recovery.
Lift the regrasped watch and carry toward blue while checking retention. Continue right-arm elbow-up retreat toward origin, leaving final home adjustment for feedback.
Place the retained second watch into blue and open, while finishing the right arm's gradual return to origin.
Second watch is outside blue; return for a more vertical grasp of its solid face. Next carry will use extra height to clear basket rims.
Advance the nearly vertical left gripper over the watch face and lower gradually for precise alignment; keep right at home.
Place the finger contact area on the watch's rigid round housing rather than loose band, close, and test with a vertical lift.
Lift watch straight up to gain generous rim clearance before any sideways transport; keep the gripping pose fixed and inspect retention.
Watch is visibly retained. Translate slowly above blue at the raised clearance height, without lowering near either basket rim.
Replan after continuity rejection: ease wrist pitch and slightly lower while moving sideways first, maintaining a raised watch and avoiding further forward extension.
Advance retained watch slowly over blue's interior with nearly constant clearance height, easing pitch to preserve continuous elbow-up configuration.
After IK guard, lower the wrist slightly and ease pitch to move the retained watch forward while reducing elbow flexion, using small increments.
Watch is now over blue's interior; lower a little, release fully, and withdraw open fingers to verify both watches settled inside.
All categories are visibly separated. Retract left above the rims with open gripper and gradually recover home orientation; keep right at origin.
Continue open left arm toward home, lowering only after clearing the baskets and recovering wrist pitch smoothly.
